40005779.author: पदार्थः
40005779.content: तदा then, सेनायाम् when the army, निविष्टायाम्  encamped, भरतः Bharata, उत्सुकः with eagerness, शत्रुघ्नम् Satrughna, अनुदर्शयन् showing, भ्रातरम् brother, द्रष्टुम् to see, जगाम went.

40005779.author: Translation
40005779.content: Eager to see his brother, Bharata encamped the army and set out showing the hermitage to Satrughna.

40005780.author: पदार्थः
40005780.content: गुरुवत्सलः devoted towards elders, सः Bharata, मे my, मातृ़ः mothers, शीघ्रम् quickly, आनय bring, इति thus, ऋषिम् rishi, वसिष्ठम् Vasistha, सन्दिश्य having conveyed, त्वरितम् quickly, अग्रे ahead, जगाम proceeded.

40005780.author: Translation
40005780.content: Bharata, deeply devoted towards elders, indicated to sage Vasistha to bring along the mothers, and  proceeded ahead quickly.

40005781.author: पदार्थः
40005781.content: सुमन्त्रस्त्वपि Sumantra on his part, शत्रुघ्नम् to Satrughna, अदूरात् not far from, अन्वपद्यत  followed, रामदर्शनजः arising from seeing Rama, तर्षः overeager, तस्य च for him also, भरतस्येव is like that of Bharata.

40005781.author: Translation
40005781.content: Sumantra, who was overeager, like Bharata, to see Rama, followed Satrughna who was not far from him.

40005782.author: पदार्थः
40005782.content: अथ thereafter, श्रीमान् the majestic one, भरतः Bharata, गच्छन्नेव while walking, तापसालयसंस्थिताम् situated like huts of hermits, भ्रातुः brother's, पर्णकुटीम् hut made of leaves, उटजं च thatched cottage, ददर्श ह beheld.

40005782.author: Translation
40005782.content: While walking, Bharata beheld a hut made of leaves looking like a hermit's cottage.

40005783.author: पदार्थः
40005783.content: तदा then, भरतः Bharata, तस्याः शालायाः that leafy hut's, अग्रतः in front of, अवभग्नानि shattered, काष्ठानि logs of wood, उपचितानि plucked, पुष्पाणि च also flowers, ददर्श beheld.

40005783.author: Translation
40005783.content: In front of that hut Bharata beheld shattered logs of wood and also flowers plucked.

40005784.author: पदार्थः
40005784.content: सः he, आश्रमम् hermitage, ईयुषः of a man proceeding towards, लक्ष्मणस्य Lakshmana's, रामस्य Rama's, क्वचित् क्वचित् here and there, वृक्षेषु on trees, कुशचीरैः with kusa grass and strips of bark, कृतम् rendered, अभिज्ञानम् as a sign to ascertain, ददर्श beheld.

40005784.author: Translation
40005784.content: Bharata beheld here and there knots of kusa grass and strips of bark tied on trees as signs to ascertain the way to the hermitage of Rama and Lakshmana.

40005785.author: पदार्थः
40005785.content: सः that Bharata, तस्मिन् वने in that forest, शीतकारणात् due to cold, मृगाणाम् deer's, महिषाणां च also of buffaloes, करीषैः dried cakes of dung, कृतान् prepared, महतः large, सञ्चयान् heaps, ददर्श beheld.

40005785.author: Translation
40005785.content: He also beheld large heaps of dried cakes of dung of buffaloes and deer for use against cold in the forest.

40005786.author: पदार्थः
40005786.content: महाबाहुः longarmed, द्युतिमान् effulgent, भरतः Bharata, तदा then, गच्छन्नेव while going, हृष्टः rejoiced, शत्रुघ्नं च to Satrughna, सर्वशः all around, तान् those, अमात्यांश्च to the ministers, अब्रवीत् said.

40005786.author: Translation
40005786.content: Walking on, the longarmed, effulgent and delighted Bharata said to Satrughna and the ministers surrounding him:

40005787.author: पदार्थः
40005787.content: यम् about which, भरद्वाजः Bharadwaja, अब्रवीत् had spoken, तं देशम् that region, प्राप्ताः स्म  we must have reached, मन्ये I think, मन्दाकिनीं नदीं Mandakini river, इतः from here, नातिदूरे not far, अहम् I, मन्ये think.

40005787.author: Translation
40005787.content: We must have reached the region about which Bharadwaja had spoken. I think river Mandakini is not far from here.

40005788.author: पदार्थः
40005788.content: चीराणि long bark garments, उच्चैः on lofty places (trees), बद्धानि have been fastened, अयम् this, अकाले at odd times, गन्तुम् to move out, इच्छता wishing, लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, अभिज्ञानकृतः marks of identification, पन्थाः भवेत् it must have been the path.

40005788.author: Translation
40005788.content: Here are long bark garments fastened on lofty places as marks of identification left by Lakshmana, to locate the path at odd times which may be needed while going out.

40005789.author: पदार्थः
40005789.content: शैलपार्श्वे on the hillside, इदम् this, उदात्तदन्तानाम् of the largetusked, तरस्विनाम् swift अन्योन्यम् charging at one another, अभिगर्जताम् trumpeting, कुञ्जराणाम् elephants', परिक्रान्तम् place.

40005789.author: Translation
40005789.content: This must be the place on the hillside on which mighty tuskers wander about trumpeting and charging at one another.

40005790.author: पदार्थः
40005790.content: वने in the forest, तापसाः ascetics, सततम् always, यमेव only whom, आधातुम् to maintain, इच्छन्ति wishing, तस्य that, कृष्णवर्त्मनः of blacktrailed fires, असौ this, सङ्कुलः thick, धूमः smoke, दृश्यते is seen.

40005790.author: Translation
40005790.content: Here is the thick smoke emanating from the blacktrailed fire maintained perpetually by the ascetics living in the forest.

40005791.author: पदार्थः
40005791.content: अहम् I, पुरुषव्याघ्रम् the best of men, Rama, गुरुसत्कारकारिणम् rendering great hospitality, आर्यम् venerable, महर्षिमिव like a great sage, राघवम् to Rama, संहृष्टः with a delighted heart, अत्र here, द्रक्ष्यामि I shall see.

40005791.author: Translation
40005791.content: I shall see here with a delighted heart the venerable Rama, the best of men, who renders great hospitality (to elders) and who resembles a maharshi.

40005792.author: पदार्थः
40005792.content: अथ thereafter, सः राघवः that Bharata, चित्रकूटम् towards Chitrakuta (mountain), मुहूर्तम् for a moment, गत्वा having gone, मन्दाकिनीम् river Mandakini, अनुप्राप्तः having reached, तं जनम्  to those people, इदम् those words, अब्रवीत् said.

40005792.author: Translation
40005792.content: Bharata walked for a short distance towards mount Chitrkuta when he reached river Mandakini. And then said to his ministers:

40005793.author: पदार्थः
40005793.content: जनेन्द्रः the lord of men, पुरषव्याघ्रः a tiger among men, निर्जनम् a place devoid of people, प्राप्य having reached, वीरासने in 'heroic' posture, रतः remaining, जगत्याम् on the ground, आस्ते is sitting, मे my, सजीवितम् life, जन्म birth, धिक् fie upon.

40005793.author: Translation
40005793.content: Rama, the lord of men, a tiger among men, is sitting on the ground in a 'heroic' (yogic) posture in this secluded forest. O fie upon my birth and my life

40005794.author: पदार्थः
40005794.content: लोकनाथः lord of the world, महाद्युतिः effulgent, राघवः Rama, मत्कृते on my account, व्यसनम्  calamity, प्राप्त: has faced, सर्वान् all, कामान् desires, परित्यज्य renouncing, वने in the forest, वसति is living.

40005794.author: Translation
40005794.content: Effulgent Rama, the lord of the world, had to renounce all desires and undergo this calamity of living in the forest on my account.

40005795.author: पदार्थः
40005795.content: इति thus, लोकसमाक्रुष्टः reviled by the world, अद्य now, प्रसादयन् seeking the grace, रामस्य Rama's, सीतायाः Sita's, लक्ष्मणस्य च and Lakshmana's, पादेषु at the feet, निपतिष्यामि shall fall down.

40005795.author: Translation
40005795.content: Reviled by the world, I shall now fall at the feet of Sita, Rama and Lakshmana seeking their grace.

40005796.author: पदार्थः
40005796.content: एवम् in that way, संविलपन् lamenting, दशरथात्मजः son of Dasaratha (Bharata), तस्मिन् वने in that forest, महतीम् great, पुण्याम् sacred, मनोरमाम् enchanting, सालतालाश्वकर्णानाम् of sala, palmyra and aswakarna trees, बहुभिः by abundance of, मृदुभिः by soft, पर्णैः with leaves, आवृताम् covered, अध्वरे in the sacrifice, कुशैः with kusa grass, तीर्णाम् spread over, विशालाम् spacious, वेदिमिव like altar, शक्रायुधनिकाशैः resembling the thunderbolt of Indra, भारसाधनैः capable of achieving targets, रुक्मपृष्ठैः goldplated, महासारै: by powerful, शत्रुबाधकैः oppressing the enemies, कार्मुकैः with bows, शोभिताम् glittering, सर्पैः with serpents, भोगवतीम् इव like Bhogavati, अर्करश्मिप्रतीकाशैः like the rays of the Sun, घोरैः by dreadful, दीप्तवदनैः with tips blazing, तूणीगतैः stored in quivers, शरैः with arrows, शोभिताम् adorned with, महारजतवासोभ्याम् scabbards made of silver, असिभ्याम् with a pair of swords, विराजिताम् was shining, रुक्मबिन्दुविचित्राभ्याम् of different colours with golden spots, चर्मभ्याम् with shields, ताम् all of them, काञ्चनभूषितैः decorated with gold, चित्रैः different kinds, आसक्तै: hung, गोधाङ्गुलित्रैः fingerguards made of skin of iguana, मृगैः with the deer, सिंहगुहामिव like the cave of a lion, अरिसङ्घै: with hordes of enemies, अनाधृष्याम् impregnable, पर्णशालाम् hut made of leave, तस्मिन् वने in that forest, ददर्श saw.

40005796.author: Translation
40005796.content: Lamenting in this way Bharata beheld in that forest an excellent, sacred and enchanting hut covered with a lot of leaves of sala, palmyra and aswakarna trees like a sacrificial altar spread with soft kusa grass. Goldplated bows that resembled the thunderbolt of Indra, powerful and capable of achieving great targets and oppressing the enemies, adorned the hut. Arrows glittering like the rays of the Sun, were dreadful, with blazing heads and stored in quivers adorned it like the hooded serpents illumining the city of Bhogavati (in the nether world). A pair of swords in scabbards made of excellent silver, two shields of different colours with golden spots, fingerguards made of skin of iguana decorated with gold were hanging there. It was impregnable to enemy hordes like the cave of a lion to the deer.

40005800.content: एवम् in that way, संविलपन् lamenting, दशरथात्मजः son of Dasaratha (Bharata), तस्मिन् वने in that forest, महतीम् great, पुण्याम् sacred, मनोरमाम् enchanting, सालतालाश्वकर्णानाम् of sala, palmyra and aswakarna trees, बहुभिः by abundance of, मृदुभिः by soft, पर्णैः with leaves, आवृताम् covered, अध्वरे in the sacrifice, कुशैः with kusa grass, तीर्णाम् spread over, विशालाम् spacious, वेदिमिव like altar, शक्रायुधनिकाशैः resembling the thunderbolt of Indra, भारसाधनैः capable of achieving targets, रुक्मपृष्ठैः goldplated, महासारै: by powerful, शत्रुबाधकैः oppressing the enemies, कार्मुकैः with bows, शोभिताम् glittering, सर्पैः with serpents, भोगवतीम् इव like Bhogavati, अर्करश्मिप्रतीकाशैः like the rays of the Sun, घोरैः by dreadful, दीप्तवदनैः with tips blazing, तूणीगतैः stored in quivers, शरैः with arrows, शोभिताम् adorned with, महारजतवासोभ्याम् scabbards made of silver, असिभ्याम् with a pair of swords, विराजिताम् was shining, रुक्मबिन्दुविचित्राभ्याम् of different colours with golden spots, चर्मभ्याम् with shields, ताम् all of them, काञ्चनभूषितैः decorated with gold, चित्रैः different kinds, आसक्तै: hung, गोधाङ्गुलित्रैः fingerguards made of skin of iguana, मृगैः with the deer, सिंहगुहामिव like the cave of a lion, अरिसङ्घै: with hordes of enemies, अनाधृष्याम् impregnable, पर्णशालाम् hut made of leave, तस्मिन् वने in that forest, ददर्श saw.

40005800.author: Translation
40005800.content: Lamenting in this way Bharata beheld in that forest an excellent, sacred and enchanting hut covered with a lot of leaves of sala, palmyra and aswakarna trees like a sacrificial altar spread with soft kusa grass. Goldplated bows that resembled the thunderbolt of Indra, powerful and capable of achieving great targets and oppressing the enemies, adorned the hut. Arrows glittering like the rays of the Sun, were dreadful, with blazing heads and stored in quivers adorned it like the hooded serpents illumining the city of Bhogavati (in the nether world). A pair of swords in scabbards made of excellent silver, two shields of different colours with golden spots, fingerguards made of skin of iguana decorated with gold were hanging there. It was impregnable to enemy hordes like the cave of a lion to the deer.

40005801.author: पदार्थः
40005801.content: एवम् in that way, संविलपन् lamenting, दशरथात्मजः son of Dasaratha (Bharata), तस्मिन् वने in that forest, महतीम् great, पुण्याम् sacred, मनोरमाम् enchanting, सालतालाश्वकर्णानाम् of sala, palmyra and aswakarna trees, बहुभिः by abundance of, मृदुभिः by soft, पर्णैः with leaves, आवृताम् covered, अध्वरे in the sacrifice, कुशैः with kusa grass, तीर्णाम् spread over, विशालाम् spacious, वेदिमिव like altar, शक्रायुधनिकाशैः resembling the thunderbolt of Indra, भारसाधनैः capable of achieving targets, रुक्मपृष्ठैः goldplated, महासारै: by powerful, शत्रुबाधकैः oppressing the enemies, कार्मुकैः with bows, शोभिताम् glittering, सर्पैः with serpents, भोगवतीम् इव like Bhogavati, अर्करश्मिप्रतीकाशैः like the rays of the Sun, घोरैः by dreadful, दीप्तवदनैः with tips blazing, तूणीगतैः stored in quivers, शरैः with arrows, शोभिताम् adorned with, महारजतवासोभ्याम् scabbards made of silver, असिभ्याम् with a pair of swords, विराजिताम् was shining, रुक्मबिन्दुविचित्राभ्याम् of different colours with golden spots, चर्मभ्याम् with shields, ताम् all of them, काञ्चनभूषितैः decorated with gold, चित्रैः different kinds, आसक्तै: hung, गोधाङ्गुलित्रैः fingerguards made of skin of iguana, मृगैः with the deer, सिंहगुहामिव like the cave of a lion, अरिसङ्घै: with hordes of enemies, अनाधृष्याम् impregnable, पर्णशालाम् hut made of leave, तस्मिन् वने in that forest, ददर्श saw.

40005801.author: Translation
40005801.content: Lamenting in this way Bharata beheld in that forest an excellent, sacred and enchanting hut covered with a lot of leaves of sala, palmyra and aswakarna trees like a sacrificial altar spread with soft kusa grass. Goldplated bows that resembled the thunderbolt of Indra, powerful and capable of achieving great targets and oppressing the enemies, adorned the hut. Arrows glittering like the rays of the Sun, were dreadful, with blazing heads and stored in quivers adorned it like the hooded serpents illumining the city of Bhogavati (in the nether world). A pair of swords in scabbards made of excellent silver, two shields of different colours with golden spots, fingerguards made of skin of iguana decorated with gold were hanging there. It was impregnable to enemy hordes like the cave of a lion to the deer.

40005802.author: पदार्थः
40005802.content: भरतः Bharata, तत्र there, रामनिवेशने at Rama's residence, प्रागुदक्प्रवणाम् sloping to the northeast, विशालाम् spacious, दीप्तपावकाम् having flaming fire, पुण्याम् sacred, वेदिम् altar, ददर्श beheld.

40005802.author: Translation
40005802.content: Bharata beheld at Rama's residence a sacred and spacious altar sloping to the northeast, with a burning fire upon it.

40005803.author: पदार्थः
40005803.content: सः भरतः that Bharata, मुहूर्तम् for a moment, निरीक्ष्य looking around, उटजे in the cottage, आसीनम् seated, जटामण्डलधारिणम् wearing matted locks of hair, गुरुम् esteemed brother, रामम् Rama, ददर्श saw.

40005803.author: Translation
40005803.content: Bharata looked around for a moment and saw his esteemed brother Rama seated in that thatched cottage wearing matted locks of hair.

40005804.author: पदार्थः
40005804.content: कृष्णाजिनधरम् clad in antelope skin, चीरवल्कलवासम् dressed in garments made of bark, अभितः near him, पावकोपमम् resembling blazing fire, आसीनम् seated, सिंहस्कन्दम् with his  shoulders like that of a lion, महाबाहुम् longarmed, पुण्डरीकनिभेक्षणम् with eyes like white lotus, सागरान्तायाः bounded by the ocean, पृथिव्याः of the earth, भर्तारम् the lord, धर्मचारिणम् follower of righteouness, तं रामम् that Rama, ददर्श saw, महाबाहुम् of longarmed one, शाश्वतम् eternal, ब्रह्माणमिव like the creator Brahma, सीतया with Sita, लक्ष्मणेन along with Lakshmana, दर्भसंस्तीर्णे on the ground strewn with darbha grass, स्थण्डिले on the bare ground, उपविष्टम् seated.

40005804.author: Translation
40005804.content: He saw Rama, lord of the oceanbound earth, seated like blazing fire, clad in antelope skin and garment of bark, with long arms and shoulders like a lion and eyes like white lotuses. The mightyarmed warrior seemed like Brahma, the creator and the eternal, protector of righteousness. Accompanied by Sita and Lakshmana Rama sat on the bare ground strewn with darbha grass.

40005805.author: पदार्थः
40005805.content: कृष्णाजिनधरम् clad in antelope skin, चीरवल्कलवासम् dressed in garments made of bark, अभितः near him, पावकोपमम् resembling blazing fire, आसीनम् seated, सिंहस्कन्दम् with his  shoulders like that of a lion, महाबाहुम् longarmed, पुण्डरीकनिभेक्षणम् with eyes like white lotus, सागरान्तायाः bounded by the ocean, पृथिव्याः of the earth, भर्तारम् the lord, धर्मचारिणम् follower of righteouness, तं रामम् that Rama, ददर्श saw, महाबाहुम् of longarmed one, शाश्वतम् eternal, ब्रह्माणमिव like the creator Brahma, सीतया with Sita, लक्ष्मणेन along with Lakshmana, दर्भसंस्तीर्णे on the ground strewn with darbha grass, स्थण्डिले on the bare ground, उपविष्टम् seated.

40005805.author: Translation
40005805.content: He saw Rama, lord of the oceanbound earth, seated like blazing fire, clad in antelope skin and garment of bark, with long arms and shoulders like a lion and eyes like white lotuses. The mightyarmed warrior seemed like Brahma, the creator and the eternal, protector of righteousness. Accompanied by Sita and Lakshmana Rama sat on the bare ground strewn with darbha grass.

40005806.author: पदार्थः
40005806.content: कृष्णाजिनधरम् clad in antelope skin, चीरवल्कलवासम् dressed in garments made of bark, अभितः near him, पावकोपमम् resembling blazing fire, आसीनम् seated, सिंहस्कन्दम् with his  shoulders like that of a lion, महाबाहुम् longarmed, पुण्डरीकनिभेक्षणम् with eyes like white lotus, सागरान्तायाः bounded by the ocean, पृथिव्याः of the earth, भर्तारम् the lord, धर्मचारिणम् follower of righteouness, तं रामम् that Rama, ददर्श saw, महाबाहुम् of longarmed one, शाश्वतम् eternal, ब्रह्माणमिव like the creator Brahma, सीतया with Sita, लक्ष्मणेन along with Lakshmana, दर्भसंस्तीर्णे on the ground strewn with darbha grass, स्थण्डिले on the bare ground, उपविष्टम् seated.

40005806.author: Translation
40005806.content: He saw Rama, lord of the oceanbound earth, seated like blazing fire, clad in antelope skin and garment of bark, with long arms and shoulders like a lion and eyes like white lotuses. The mightyarmed warrior seemed like Brahma, the creator and the eternal, protector of righteousness. Accompanied by Sita and Lakshmana Rama sat on the bare ground strewn with darbha grass.

40005807.author: पदार्थः
40005807.content: श्रीमान् majestic, भरतः Bharata, तम् that Rama, दृष्ट्वा having seen, दुःखशोकपरिप्लुतः overwhelmed with grief and distress, धर्मात्मा righteous, कैकयीसुतः son of Kaikeyi, भरतः Bharata, अभ्यधावत ran towards him.

40005807.author: Translation
40005807.content: Beholding Rama, Bharata the majestic and righteous son of Kaikeyi overwhelmed with grief and distress rushed towards him.

40005808.author: पदार्थः
40005808.content: दृष्ट्वैव as soon as he saw, आर्तः anguished, बाष्पसन्दिग्धया choked with tears, गिरा with words, विललाप lamented, धैर्यात् with courage, धारयितुम् to restrain, अशक्नुवन् being unable, वचनम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.

40005808.author: Translation
40005808.content: On seeing Rama, Bharata could not control his grief with patience and lamented in great anguish and with words choked with tears said:

40005809.author: पदार्थः
40005809.content: यः he who, संसदि in the royal assembly, प्रकृतिभिः by ministers and other subjects, उपासितुम् to be attended upon, युक्तः one who deserves, भवेत् becomes, सः he, अयम् this, man, मम my, अग्रजः elder brother, वन्यैः wild, मृगैः by the beasts, उपासीनः आस्ते is being attended.

40005809.author: Translation
40005809.content: My elder brother who deserves to be attended by ministers and other subjects in the royal assembly sits here today in the forest surrounded by wild beasts.

40005810.author: पदार्थः
40005810.content: यः महात्मा that magnanimous (Rama), पुरा formerly, बहुसाहस्रैः with many thousands, वासोभिः with clothes, उचितः was accustomed, सः such, अयम् now, धर्मम् righteousness, आचरन् practising, मृगाजिने two deer kins, प्रवस्ते is wearing.

40005810.author: Translation
40005810.content: Such magnanimous Rama, a follower of dharma, accustomed to be attired in  thousands of dresses in the past now clad in two deer skins, is practising righteousness.

40005811.author: पदार्थः
40005811.content: यः that Rama, तदा then, विविधाः various, चित्राः colours, सुमनसः flowers, आधारयत् wore, सः such a man, अयं राघवः this Rama, इमं जटाभारम् the weight of matted hair, कथम् how, वहते is able to bear?

40005811.author: Translation
40005811.content: How is it that Rama who used to wear variegated flowers formerly, now bears these heavy matted locks?

40005812.author: पदार्थः
40005812.content: यथोद्विष्टैः in accordance with desire, यज्ञैः with sacrifices, यस्य to whom, धर्मस्य righteousness, सञ्चयः accumulation, युक्तः was quite possible, सः such Rama, शरीरक्लेशसंभूतम् rising due to mortification of body, धर्मम् righteouness, परिमार्गते is seeking.

40005812.author: Translation
40005812.content: That Rama, who in accordance with tradition deserves accredition of religious merit through sacrifices now seeks it through mortification of body.

40005813.author: पदार्थः
40005813.content: यस्य whose, अङ्गम् body, महार्हेण by highly valuable, चन्दनेन with sandal paste, उपसेवितम्  smeared, तस्य his, आर्यस्य esteemed brother's, इदम् अङ्गम् this body, मलेन with dirt, कथम् how, सेव्यते is being served?

40005813.author: Translation
40005813.content: How is it that the body of my venerable brother which was once smeared with expensive, fragrant sandal paste is now covered with dust?

40005814.author: पदार्थः
40005814.content: सुखोचितः accustomed to comforts, रामः Rama, मन्निमित्तम् on my account, इदं दुःखम् this misfortune, प्राप्तः has obtained, नृशंसस्य of a cruel one, मम my, लोकविगर्हितम् condemned by the world, जीवितम् धिक् fie on my life.

40005814.author: Translation
40005814.content: It is on my account that Rama who was accustomed to all comforts has fallen into this misfortune. Fie on my life of cruelty which is condemned by the world.

40005815.author: पदार्थः
40005815.content: भरतः Bharata, दीनः miserable, प्रस्विन्नमुखपङ्कजः lotuslike countenance full of sweat, इत्येवम् thus, विलपन् lamenting, रामस्य Rama's, पादौ feet, अप्राप्य before reaching, रुदन् crying in distress, पपात fell down.

40005815.author: Translation
40005815.content: Thus Bharata lamented in misery and with his lotuslike countenanace sweating  before reaching Rama's feet fell down, crying in distress.

40005816.author: पदार्थः
40005816.content: महाबलः mighty, राजपुत्रः prince, भरतः Bharata, दुःखाभितप्तः oppressed with grief, आर्य इति saying o Arya (venerable one), सकृत् once, दीनम् in distress, उक्त्वा having said, पुनः again, किञ्चन anything, नोवाच could not speak.

40005816.author: Translation
40005816.content: Mighty prince Bharata, oppressed with grief, could only say, O Arya (venerable one) And in distress could not speak any more.

40005817.author: पदार्थः
40005817.content: यशस्विनम् glorious, रामम् Rama, प्रेक्ष्य on seeing, बाष्पाभिहतकण्ठश्च with choked throat, अथ then, आर्येत्येव O Arya, सङ्क्रुश्य crying out, तदा thereafter, व्याहर्तुम् to talk further, नाशकत् was not able.

40005817.author: Translation
40005817.content: As he beheld the glorious Rama, with his throat choken with tears, he cried out, O Arya (venerable one) and thereafter, was unable to speak any more.

40005818.author: पदार्थः
40005818.content: शत्रुघ्नश्चापि Satrughna too, रुदन् weeping, रामस्य Rama's, चरणौ feet, ववन्दे prostrated, सः रामश्च that Rama also, तौ उभौ the two of them, समालिङ्ग्य having embraced, अश्रूणि  tears, अवर्तयत् shed.

40005818.author: Translation
40005818.content: Satrughna also prostrated himself at the feet of tearful Rama who embraced both of them.

40005819.author: पदार्थः
40005819.content: ततः therafter, अरण्ये in the forest, राजसुतौ the princes (Rama and Lakshmana), अम्बरे in the sky, दिवाकरश्चैव Sun, निशाकरश्च Moon, शुक्रबृहस्पतिभ्याम् with Sukra and Brihaspathi, यथा similarly, सुमन्त्रेण with Sumantra, गुहेन चैव with Guha, समीयतुः met.

40005819.author: Translation
40005819.content: Thereafter, princes Rama and Lakshmana joined Sumantra and Guha in the forest like the Sun and the Moon meeting the planets Sukra and Brihaspati in the sky.

40005820.author: पदार्थः
40005820.content: ते सर्वे they all, वनौकसः inhabitants of the forest, तत्र there, महति in great, अरण्ये in the forest, समागतान् united, वारणयूथपाभान् with the effulgence of mighty leaders of elephant herds, तान् पार्थिवान् those kings, समीक्ष्य on seeing, हर्षम् delight, प्रविहाय having forsaken, अश्रूणि tears, अमुञ्चन् shed.

40005820.author: Translation
40005820.content: On seeing the princes now assembled in the great forest like mighty leaders of elephant herds, inhabitants of the forest had nothing but tears of grief, not joy, to shed. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे एकोनशततमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the ninetyninth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
